'''Norbo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] whose enterprises included [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geldoll]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When Geldoll banned all Hutt vessels and agents from the planet in an effort to combat smuggling, he was forced to find new agents to deliver his shipments.
